searchResults.resultSnippet: Order Online — order and pay ahead, then skip the line at either shop. Oak Street Bakes is a neighborhood bakery with two shops in Chicago.

Oak Street Bakes is owned by Dale Pruitt, who opened the first shop in Hyde Park in 2011. We have two locations, and two is the plan.
